labels.t_head2:
Acquires the zk lock, processes,

labels.t_sense:
After sensing the lock

labels.t_only: zookeeper guarantees only one party can acquire this lock
labels._desc: Two System A instances compete for a ZooKeeper lock: the first acquires, processes and releases it, while the other registers a listener and retries once it senses the release.
